title: MiniNotes.app — Custom Notes and Collections using WebMCP
pitch: Create custom Notes and Collections from your AI chat thread using WebMCP
about_excerpt:

 mininotes.app shows how powerful WebMCP is by surfacing the ability to add notes, custom fields and save them as collections to any client supporting the standard. 

 Users can instantly create custom note types, organize them, and save notes to the website without manual interaction by sending messages directly to the chat. The website can interact with any AI client that supports a WebMCP integrated web browser that will complete the tasks autonomously using AI Agents. 

 The chat client provides the AI shell around your app and that progressively enhances your experience without needing a total rewrite of your application or additional integration of an AI provider to your code.
